newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Confirmed - None.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. 129,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 34,800 formulated, 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 2,400 head or 59 loads CME cattle deliveries.

The last established market was $65.00 per cwt on Wednesday, packers bids not available, asking prices $65.00-$66.00. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
